relations.subject: Thubten Yeshe
relations.evidence: Lama Yeshe was born near the Tibetan town of Tolung Dechen, and was sent to Sera Monastery in Lhasa at the age of six.

relations.subject: Thubten Yeshe
relations.evidence: There, his teacher Geshe Rabten entrusted to his care a younger monk, Thubten Zopa Rinpoche.

relations.subject: Thubten Zopa Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Thubten Yeshe and his main student, Thubten Zopa Rinpoche, founded Kopan Monastery in Kathmandu, Nepal

relations.subject: Thubten Yeshe
relations.evidence: The two would work together throughout Lama Yeshe's life.

relations.subject: Thubten Yeshe
relations.evidence: Between 1977 and 1978, Lama Yeshe taught at University of California Santa Cruz. There he taught one class, "Tibetan Buddhism", appropriately.

relations.subject: Thubten Yeshe
relations.evidence: co-founded Kopan Monastery (1969) and the Foundation for the Preservation of the Mahayana Tradition (1975)
